title: Jaclyn B
content: At about 11 PM on July 28, 2025, I was driving and was in an auto accident. I was T-boned by a drunk driver. My car rolled over multiple times and landed upside down in a lake or canal. I was instantly submerged in water. I didn’t realize I was upside down until the next day when I saw videos. Physically, it shouldn't have been possible. But, I had a small pocket of air in the upper left corner of the car. Moving even slightly made this pocket of air shrink. The water covered my ears, and everything became eerily quiet as I tried to stay calm and find a way out. The water kept rising, and my air pocket continued to grow smaller. I started choking when I tried to breathe. When I realized I couldn’t escape or hold my breath any longer, I said my goodbyes. Just before losing consciousness, I felt my arm being pulled. The next thing I remember is being in a hospital room after traveling through a long, black tunnel into outer space, deep in the galaxy. I arrived at what looked like a pink planet which seemed like an alternate reality. A higher power was with me in physical form, although it appeared as a black silhouette. It guided me around the place. I saw people who I knew had passed away on earth. The silhouette showed me an area with benches where people sat with their heads down, looking depressed. When I asked about them, it explained they were people who had committed suicide and regretted it. Those people who didn’t regret it, lived peacefully among the others, as if in another version of Earth. Everyone was walking around. I felt overwhelming peace and love like never before. Occasionally, I heard my name being screamed and felt people pressing down on me. It was as if my body was fighting between life and death. I just wanted to sleep. I was clinically dead for six minutes before my loved ones and the silhouette told me it wasn’t my time. So, I had to go back to my body. I’ve always been psychic but never embraced it. Since then, multiple souls have been reaching out to me in real life, and I’m unsure how to handle it. Some of these souls I had known and others were unknown to me. Twice, strangers stopped me on the street, saying my deceased best friend had a message for me. Both knew extremely specific details about his death such as his name, car color, and location. These are things they couldn’t have known otherwise. Now, there are many times when I’m lying in bed and feel someone standing over me or lying beside me. I sense powerful energies around me. Some energies are negative and some are positive. It’s as if this experience opened some sort of portal. This experience happened only e weeks ago, so I guess this is the start of a new journey in life.
